description: This file defines the IMiracastPlayer interface for Miracast playback control, including states, reason codes, device parameters, video rectangle, result, environment arguments, and notifications. It declares methods for registration, playback control, environment configuration, and event notification.

classes.name: IMiracastPlayer
classes.description: Interface for Miracast playback control, including state management, notifications, and environment configuration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for Miracast events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: PlayRequest
methods.description: Start Miracast playback with device parameters and video rectangle.

methods.name: StopRequest
methods.description: Stop Miracast playback for a specific client.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Set the video rectangle for Miracast playback.
